fix(codex): persist continuation intent

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-18
  description: |-
    Record a fence- and expiry-scoped continuation-start marker before dispatching a replacement Codex turn. Restart recovery now treats a marker without an exact replacement reference as unknown, preventing both duplicate sends and fallback to the cancelled original turn.
    
    Add runner and PostgreSQL crash-boundary regressions for pre-send ordering, replay refusal, and exact-reference readback.
